text: The Environmental Nominating Panel must select candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF) Board to fill two vacancies. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its June 13, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to City Council.

The Environmental Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following six candidates for interview at its June 13, 2018 meeting for appointment to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board: Candidate # 36 Candidate # 65 Candidate # 78 Candidate # 96 Candidate # 108 Candidate # 115 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 17, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board.
